subject.statement: Greg Abel replaced Warren Buffett as Berkshire Hathaway's chairman and CEO.
disambiguators: replaced Warren Buffett as Berkshire Hathaway's chairman and CEO

summary: As of the latest public information up to 2026, Warren Buffett remained chairman and CEO of Berkshire Hathaway; Greg Abel was named as the designated successor but had not yet assumed those roles.
